extracted.name: Tex-Mex Jalapeño Corn Bread
extracted.description: #GoldenApron23. A different way to use corn.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit. Grease or spray an 8 inch square baking dish.
In a large bowl combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Add milk, egg and oil. Beat until fairly smooth.
Add 1 cup whole kernel corn and 1/2 cup cheddar cheese and 2 diced jalapeños.
Place batter in prepared baking dish.
Bake 20-23 minutes until brown around edges and wooden pick in center comes out clean.
Cool for a few minutes before slicing.
